title: Marguerite and the Typewriter
author: S. M. Joubert
blurb: Petra Crane, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
